title: Ultrasound Implant Improves Brain Drug Delivery
summary: An implantable device uses ultrasound to improve targeted drug delivery to the brain and help prevent tumor recurrence.

title: Senseonics Launches Eversense CGM Study
summary: Senseonics launched a human feasibility study for a transmitter-free version of its Eversense 365 continuous glucose monitor.

title: Origin Nuclear and SGE UK Form SMR Joint Venture
summary: Origin Nuclear and SGE UK signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture to support the deployment of 14 SMRs in the UK.

title: Panel-Level Processing Scales Advanced AI Packaging
summary: Panel-level processing is emerging as a critical path to scale advanced chip packaging as AI pushes beyond traditional wafer limits.

title: Space-Drawn ZBLAN Fibers Show Strength
summary: Engineers successfully produced long ZBLAN optical fibers in microgravity aboard the International Space Station, resulting in stronger fibers.

title: Rubin Telescope to Find Mini-Moons
summary: The Rubin telescope is expected to help discover more of Earth's temporary mini-moons for potential future space missions.

title: KOA Speer Releases Heat Shock Resistors
summary: KOA Speer Electronics introduced a new family of heat shock resistors featuring a metal glaze resistance film.

title: Ancient Solar Eclipse Reveals Earth Rotation Secrets
summary: Scientists analyzed a 2,700-year-old solar eclipse by correcting an ancient capital's location to measure past Earth rotation speeds.

title: CScale Exits Stealth with $145M Funding
summary: Optical interconnect startup CScale exited stealth mode with $145 million in Series C funding backed by Nvidia and Intel Capital.

title: Magnetic Vortices Film Advances Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Scientists filmed magnetic vortices melting out of an organized lattice, offering new ways to enable brain-like computing technology.

title: Apprenticeships and SAR Satellites Highlighted in Tech News
summary: Recent industry highlights include the Apprenticeship Talent Bridge launch, a flapping airplanes startup, and ongoing expansion of Iceye's SAR satellite constellation.

title: Self-Heating and Parasitics Hinder Multi-Tier CFET Scaling
summary: Researchers from TU Munich and IIT Kanpur studied how self-heating and parasitics impact multi-tier CFET design with vertically stacked nanosheet devices.

title: Algorithm Optimizes Aircraft Torque Link Mass by 23 Percent
summary: Researchers applied an improved Schrödinger-based optimization approach to reduce the mass of an aircraft torque link from 4.053 kg to 3.115 kg using finite element analysis.

title: Harness Engineering Workflow Enables Agentic Wireless DSP Generation
summary: A new workflow surrounding large language models with hardware architecture guidance enables the generation and deployment of valid wireless digital signal processing RTL designs on RFSoC platforms.

title: UnderTone Brings Frequency Lock Encoding to COTS Wi-Fi Hardware
summary: Researchers implemented Frequency Lock Encoding on standard ESP32-C5 microcontrollers by reverse-engineering fractional-N divider registers to induce precise carrier frequency offsets.

title: V2C MXene Heterostructures Enhance Nano-Aluminum Reactivity
summary: Combining nano-aluminum with a V2C MXene heterostructure suppresses agglomeration, etches alumina shells, and significantly increases peak heat flow and combustion performance.

title: Pt-W Alloy Evaluated for High-NA EUV Mask Absorbers
summary: Researchers investigated a platinum-tungsten alloy as a potential low-n EUV mask absorber to enable thinner films and better imaging performance.

title: Brax Unveils Modular Phone Focused on Privacy
summary: Brax is developing a new modular smartphone that prioritizes maximum privacy through dedicated hardware switches.

title: Arm Responds to Jury Decision in Qualcomm Trial
summary: Arm's Ami Badani cited a $2 nominal damages award as validation following the recent Qualcomm trial decision.

title: Webinar to Cover FCC Robotics Ruling Impact
summary: Industry leaders are hosting a webinar to discuss how new FCC restrictions on connected systems affect automation buyers.

title: Trump Administration Targets Offshore Wind Permits
summary: The administration is asking a federal judge to let it reconsider a major federal permit granted for an offshore wind farm.

title: Generative Bionics Launches Physical AI Data Factory
summary: Generative Bionics is launching a new data factory in Italy to advance European robotics sovereignty and humanoid data generation.
